# @retrojb/ui and @retrojb/tokens

> A React component library (`@retrojb/ui`) and its design tokens
> (`@retrojb/tokens`). Tailwind CSS 4 styling, WCAG 2 accessibility built in,
> light and dark themes, ESM only. Source: https://github.com/Retrojb/retrojb-mcps

This file is for AI coding agents working in a project that uses these
packages. Follow it instead of guessing from other design systems.

## Install

    npm install @retrojb/ui react@19.2.8 react-dom@19.2.8 @tanstack/react-table@9.2.4

- Node >=24. React, React DOM and @tanstack/react-table are peer dependencies
  pinned to those exact versions, with no range.
- `@retrojb/tokens` is a dependency of `@retrojb/ui` and is bundled into its
  stylesheet. Do not install it separately unless the project wants tokens
  without components.
- Tailwind is not needed to render the components.

## Import the stylesheet once, at the app entry point

    import "@retrojb/ui/styles.css"; // app/layout.tsx (Next.js) or src/main.tsx (Vite)

Do this in the entry point, not inside a component module. Without it every
component renders unstyled.

## Use components

    import { Button, Input, Link } from "@retrojb/ui";

    <Input label="Email" type="email" description="We never share it." />
    <Button text="Sign up" type="submit" />
    <Link href="/privacy">Privacy policy</Link>

Rules that differ from most libraries:

- `Button` takes its label as the `text` prop. Children are not the label.
- `Button` defaults to `type="button"`. Pass `type="submit"` to submit a form.
- `Input` requires `label`. Use `labelHidden` to hide it visually. Pass `error`
  to show an invalid state; there is no separate invalid prop.
- `Table` requires `caption` and takes a TanStack Table v9 instance as `table`.
  It does not build one.
- Every component is a named export from `@retrojb/ui`. Props interfaces are
  `I<Name>Props` (`IButtonProps`). Variant functions are exported too
  (`buttonStyle`, `linkStyle`, `inputStyle`, `tableStyle`).
- Variants are props: `<Button intent="secondary" size="lg" fullWidth />`. Read
  the component's TSDoc or types for the allowed values.

Exported components: Avatar, BrowserAlert, Button, Card (CardHeader, CardTitle,
CardBody, CardFooter), Checkbox, CheckboxGroup, Chip, Code, CodeBlock,
CodeSnippet, ComboBox, Drawer, DynamicContainer, Emphasis, GraphicCard,
GridItem, Icon, InlineAlert, Input, InteractiveCard, Link, List, ListItem,
Modal, PageGrid, PageHeading, Paragraph, ProductHeading, ProgressBar, Radio,
RadioGroup, Reference, SearchBox, SectionHeading, SegmentedControl, Strong,
SubHeading, Tab, TabGroup, TabList, TabPanel, Table (TableHead, TableBody,
TableRow, TableHeaderCell, TableCell, TableFoot, TableEmpty), Tag, TitleHeading,
ToastAlert, ToastRegion, Toggle.

The npm release can trail the main branch. If an import is missing, check the
installed version.

## Icons

Lucide icons come from a subpath, not the main entry:

    import { Icon } from "@retrojb/ui";
    import { Search } from "@retrojb/ui/icons";
    <Icon icon={Search} />

## Using Tailwind classes in the app's own markup

Only needed if the app writes utilities such as `bg-accent` itself.

    npm install -D tailwindcss@4.3.3 @tailwindcss/postcss@4.3.3

PostCSS config: `export default { plugins: { "@tailwindcss/postcss": {} } };`

    /* app/globals.css */
    @layer theme, base, components;
    @import "tailwindcss/theme.css" layer(theme);
    @import "tailwindcss/utilities.css";
    @import "@retrojb/ui/theme.css";
    @source "./**/*.tsx";
    @source "../node_modules/@retrojb/ui/dist";

Import `@retrojb/ui/styles.css` first, then `./globals.css`.

- Do not `@import "tailwindcss"`. That adds a preflight reset the library does
  not assume.
- Keep the `@source` line for `@retrojb/ui/dist`. Without it, app utilities can
  override component utilities (a 4px `border-s-4` becomes 1px).
- There is no `tailwind.config.js`. Tailwind 4 is configured in CSS.
- Do not use `dark:`. Themes switch through tokens, so one class works in both.

## Styling rules for code you write

- Use semantic colour utilities: `bg-background`, `bg-surface-base`,
  `bg-surface-raised-1`, `text-foreground`, `text-foreground-muted`,
  `bg-accent`, `text-accent-foreground`, `text-accent-text`, `bg-danger`,
  `text-success`. Do not use ramp steps such as `bg-primary-8`; they ignore
  theme overrides.
- Use `border-border-strong` for the border of a control or a meaningful box.
  `border-border` is decorative only and fails WCAG 1.4.11 contrast.
- Type roles set size, line height, weight and tracking together: `text-body-md`,
  `text-body-sm`, `text-heading-md`, `text-caption` and similar.
- Radius: `rounded-control` for interactive surfaces.
- Focus: `outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus`.
  Use an outline, not a ring, so it survives forced-colors mode.
- Pair every `transition-*` class with `motion-reduce:transition-none`.
- Spacing tokens are `--space-*`. Write `p-(--space-4)`. Do not write `p-4`.

## Tokens only

    npm install @retrojb/tokens

    @import "@retrojb/tokens";   /* both themes */

Also `@retrojb/tokens/light.css` and `@retrojb/tokens/dark.css`. Use one. Do not
import a token file next to `@retrojb/ui/styles.css`, which includes them.
Properties include `--background`, `--foreground`, `--accent`, `--border-strong`,
`--focus-ring`, the ramps `--primary-0` to `--primary-9` (also `--secondary-*`
and `--neutral-*`), and `--space-*`. Themed colours use `light-dark()`.

## Theme and density

- The theme follows `prefers-color-scheme`. Force one with
  `<html data-theme="light">` or `<html data-theme="dark">`.
- Density: `data-density="compact" | "comfort" | "spacious"` on `<html>` or any
  element. The nearest ancestor wins.
- Override tokens with an unlayered rule. No `!important` needed:

      :root { --accent: #6d28d9; }

- Brand fonts: set `--font-family-sans` and `--font-family-mono` on the element
  that holds the font variables (put `next/font` classes on `<html>`).
- Re-check contrast after changing a colour.

## Next.js notes

- Components are client modules. Variant functions are not, so call
  `linkStyle()` and the others from server components:

      <NextLink href="/docs" className={linkStyle({ intent: "standalone" })}>Docs</NextLink>

- Put `lang` on `<html>`.

## Common failures

- Unstyled components: `@retrojb/ui/styles.css` is not imported.
- `ERESOLVE` on install: React, React DOM or @tanstack/react-table is not at the
  pinned version.
- `bg-accent` has no effect in app markup: `@retrojb/ui/theme.css` is not
  imported in the app's Tailwind CSS.
- A TypeScript error on `<Input>`: the required `label` prop is missing.
